title: Slimwave rollout cadence & release draft
body:
Context:
Slimwave (adaptive model routing v2) is an operational change that introduces weighted routing by latency/cost tiers and a soft-fallback path for capacity pressure. This doc captures the release cadence, concise preflight checks, the canary schedule across regions, and a short draft of release notes. Purpose is to have a single compact runbook for the launch window and immediate stabilization.

Scope:
- Core change: routing policy switch to `slimwave` algorithm + enable region-local fallback variant (model: slimwave-compat-1).
- Surface changes: routing table updates, new telemetry tags (route.variant, route.score), config toggles in control-plane.
- Not included: model weights, quantization changes, or tenant-specific policy overrides (handled separately).

High-level timeline (UTC):
- T-72h: Final config freeze, integration smoke (staging).
- T-48h: Canary config pushed to canary pool (internal only), alerting hooks added.
- T-24h: Nightly dry run (synthetic traffic) across us-west1, europe-west1.
- Launch day (D): 09:00 — start 1% canary (us-west1); 11:00 — expand to 5% if gates pass; 14:00 — 20% expansion (global); 18:00 — 50% (if all green); 22:00 — full ramp (100%) or hold for gradual finish.
- Post-launch stabilization: D+1 to D+3 — full telemetry sweep and quality evals against golden prompt set.

Preflight checklist (owners and Jira refs):
- [ ] Config freeze confirmed and checked into control-plane repo (owner: Evan Park) — JIRA-INF-1847.
- [ ] Canary pool capacity reserved and smoke VMs scheduled (owner: Ravi Singh).
- [ ] Telemetry pipeline updated: new tags and a retention note (owner: Liu Chen).
- [ ] Canary synthetic load scripts validated (owner: Sophie Alvarez).
- [ ] Release notes draft prepared and legal reviewed for privacy lines (owner: Maya Thompson).
- [ ] Rollback artifact identified and tested (owner: Release Engineer on call).

Go / No-Go criteria (must all be satisfied to progress to next step):
- Latency: p95 change <= +40ms compared to baseline for canary traffic for the same request mix.
- Error rate: 5xx rate <= baseline + 0.02% absolute.
- Cost signals: cost-per-request change <= +7% for sustained 30m window.
- Quality: BLEU/ROUGE-style synthetic prompting checks: top-1 token drift score <= 0.03 vs baseline on golden set.
- Observability: route.variant and route.score present in traces for >= 99% of requests.

Canary schedule (with thresholds and owners):
- Phase 0 (internal): T-48h — internal canary, 1000 rps synthetic in us-west1. Gates: smoke only, no customer traffic. Owner: Ravi.
- Phase 1 (1%): D 09:00 — 1% of production split in us-west1 only for 60 minutes. Gate thresholds checked every 15m by on-call. Owner: Evan.
- Phase 2 (5%): D 11:00 — expand to 5% (us-west1 + europe-west1). Hold 90m, run traffic sculpting. Owner: Release lead.
- Phase 3 (20%): D 14:00 — global 20% (asia fallback remains off). Hold 2h, perform quality evals and user-sample checks. Owner: Maya.
- Phase 4 (50%): D 18:00 — expand to 50% if no regressions. Owner: Release lead.
- Phase 5 (100%): D 22:00 — full rollover only if all metrics stable for 90m.

Fallback mapping and behavior:
- When route.score falls below 0.45 for 30s window or GPU queue depth exceeds 80% for 60s, route switches to `slimwave-compat-1` variant in same region.
- If regional capacity triggers fallback for 2 consecutive minutes, control-plane will mark region as warm-fallback and route new sessions to neighboring region per heatmap.
- Circuit-breaker: if total fallbacks exceed 15% of global requests in a 5m window, auto-throttle ramp and send page to eng-sre.

Rollback plan (fastest safe path):
- Immediate rollback (on-call): flip `routing.algorithm` feature flag to `legacy` in control-plane API. This toggles all routing decisions back to previous behavior within 5s. Owner: on-call infra.
- If feature flag flip does not restore baseline within 2m, initiate traffic cutover to cold standby region (runbook step ID: RB-02). Owner: SRE lead.
- Post-rollback: run full traffic re-verification for 60m and collect traces for postmortem.

Monitoring and dashboards to watch (minimum):
- Control-plane metrics: routing.decisions.per_s, fallback.rate (region), queue.depth (instance).
- Serving runtime: p50/p95 latency, token throughput, memory pressure OOM warnings.
- Customer-facing: 500s, 429s, increased latency SLA breaches.
- Quality: golden prompt regression dashboard, sample-of-requests diff view, hallucination detector rate.
- Alerts: defined Slack/Tiered pages for immediate (>15% fallback) and degraded (p95 > baseline + 40ms).

Communication plan:
- Pre-launch: Slack #release-ops pinned summary T-24h, include runbook link and primary contacts.
- Launch day: periodic updates at each phase expansion (Evan posts status: pass/warn/fail).
- Post-launch: summary note + artifacts (traces, dashboards) posted to Confluence and #eng-all.

Short release notes draft (to be edited before publish):
- Feature: Introduced Slimwave adaptive routing (v2) to improve latency and cost tradeoffs by routing requests to the best-fit serving variant.
- Impact: Gradual rollout; minimal developer-visible changes. Expect slightly improved median latency for geo-local requests and more consistent handling when GPUs are constrained.
- Rollout: Canary then progressive ramp; will monitor and automatically fallback to compatibility variant under load.
- Admin notes: New telemetry tags (route.variant, route.score) available in tracing; update dashboards if you use custom alerts.

Open questions / low-risk follow-ups:
- Confirm whether tenant override precedence needs a manual opt-in during rollout (owner: product).
- Decide final alert thresholds for cost signals (owner: finance partnership).
- Add a short snippet to the SDK changelog indicating new trace tags (owner: DX team).

Post-launch retro agenda (D+3):
- What went well (timing, gating).
- What failed / surprises (fallback rate spikes, telemetry gaps).
- Action items (owners + ETA).

Quick annex — commands (ops cheatsheet):
- Toggle algorithm: curl -X POST https://control-plane.redwood.internal/api/v1/feature/toggle -d '{"routing.algorithm":"legacy"}'
- Query fallback rate (last 5m): /observability/query?m=fallback.rate&range=5m

Notes: this is a working draft intended to be minimal and actionable during the launch window. Please add any missing preflight checks or owner assignments directly in the doc and ping stakeholders.
